"87312669-caa3-5cc6-a042-e2cd54f8a473" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{4}{|2 x|\sqrt{4 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

Work on a connected interval where $|2 x|>1$.

Choose the antiderivative. In each choice, $C$ is an arbitrary constant."] [:db/add "87312669-caa3-5cc6-a042-e2cd54f8a473" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=2 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(2)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{2}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $4\cdot \frac{1}{2}=2$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{4}{|2 x|\sqrt{4 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=2\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

$$
2\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=2\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
2 \operatorname{arcsec}{\left(2 x \right)}+C.
$$"] [:db/add "87312669-caa3-5cc6-a042-e2cd54f8a473" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "87312669-caa3-5cc6-a042-e2cd54f8a473" :question/answer-fields "0761b053-225a-50eb-b3c7-badb01d12f61" :question/id #uuid "0761b053-225a-50eb-b3c7-badb01d12f61"] [:db/add "0761b053-225a-50eb-b3c7-badb01d12f61" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{5}{|5 x|\sqrt{25 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

Work on a connected interval where $|5 x|>1$.

Choose the antiderivative. In each choice, $C$ is an arbitrary constant."] [:db/add "0761b053-225a-50eb-b3c7-badb01d12f61" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=5 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(5)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{5}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $5\cdot \frac{1}{5}=1$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{5}{|5 x|\sqrt{25 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u.\end{aligned}
$$

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(5 x \right)}+C.
$$"] [:db/add "0761b053-225a-50eb-b3c7-badb01d12f61" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "0761b053-225a-50eb-b3c7-badb01d12f61" :question/answer-fields "2d4c5a11-05bf-535e-9aa3-7c44f0124393" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{4}{|4 x|\sqrt{16 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

Work on a connected interval where $|4 x|>1$.

Choose the antiderivative. In each choice, $C$ is an arbitrary constant."] [:db/add "2d4c5a11-05bf-535e-9aa3-7c44f0124393" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=4 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(4)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{4}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $4\cdot \frac{1}{4}=1$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{4}{|4 x|\sqrt{16 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u.\end{aligned}
$$

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(4 x \right)}+C.
$$"] [:db/add "2d4c5a11-05bf-535e-9aa3-7c44f0124393" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "2d4c5a11-05bf-535e-9aa3-7c44f0124393" :question/answer-fields "3dcaa520-2b5c-5e6e-94c1-9fe1c20541f8" :question/id #uuid "3dcaa520-2b5c-5e6e-94c1-9fe1c20541f8"] [:db/add "3dcaa520-2b5c-5e6e-94c1-9fe1c20541f8" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{3}{|4 x|\sqrt{16 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

Work on a connected interval where $|4 x|>1$.

Choose the antiderivative. In each choice, $C$ is an arbitrary constant."] [:db/add "3dcaa520-2b5c-5e6e-94c1-9fe1c20541f8" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=4 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(4)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{4}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $3\cdot \frac{1}{4}=\frac{3}{4}$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{3}{|4 x|\sqrt{16 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{3}{4}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

$$
\frac{3}{4}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=\frac{3}{4}\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
\frac{3 \operatorname{arcsec}{\left(4 x \right)}}{4}+C.
$$"] [:db/add "3dcaa520-2b5c-5e6e-94c1-9fe1c20541f8" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "3dcaa520-2b5c-5e6e-94c1-9fe1c20541f8" :question/answer-fields "af0cf89b-f732-5f0a-8c57-8613ad487f68" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{1}{|x|\sqrt{4 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

Work on a connected interval where $|2 x|>1$.

Choose the antiderivative. In each choice, $C$ is an arbitrary constant."] [:db/add "af0cf89b-f732-5f0a-8c57-8613ad487f68" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=2 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(2)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{2}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $2\cdot \frac{1}{2}=1$.

$$

$$

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(2 x \right)}+C.

"87312669-caa3-5cc6-a042-e2cd54f8a473" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{4}{|2 x|\sqrt{4 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

Work on a connected interval where $|2 x|>1$.

Choose the antiderivative. In each choice, $C$ is an arbitrary constant."] [:db/add "87312669-caa3-5cc6-a042-e2cd54f8a473" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=2 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(2)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{2}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $4\cdot \frac{1}{2}=2$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{4}{|2 x|\sqrt{4 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=2\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

$$
2\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=2\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
2 \operatorname{arcsec}{\left(2 x \right)}+C.
$$"] [:db/add "87312669-caa3-5cc6-a042-e2cd54f8a473" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "87312669-caa3-5cc6-a042-e2cd54f8a473" :question/answer-fields "0761b053-225a-50eb-b3c7-badb01d12f61" :question/id #uuid "0761b053-225a-50eb-b3c7-badb01d12f61"] [:db/add "0761b053-225a-50eb-b3c7-badb01d12f61" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{5}{|5 x|\sqrt{25 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

Work on a connected interval where $|5 x|>1$.

Choose the antiderivative. In each choice, $C$ is an arbitrary constant."] [:db/add "0761b053-225a-50eb-b3c7-badb01d12f61" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=5 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(5)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{5}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $5\cdot \frac{1}{5}=1$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{5}{|5 x|\sqrt{25 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u.\end{aligned}
$$

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(5 x \right)}+C.
$$"] [:db/add "0761b053-225a-50eb-b3c7-badb01d12f61" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "0761b053-225a-50eb-b3c7-badb01d12f61" :question/answer-fields "2d4c5a11-05bf-535e-9aa3-7c44f0124393" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{4}{|4 x|\sqrt{16 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

Work on a connected interval where $|4 x|>1$.

Choose the antiderivative. In each choice, $C$ is an arbitrary constant."] [:db/add "2d4c5a11-05bf-535e-9aa3-7c44f0124393" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=4 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(4)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{4}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $4\cdot \frac{1}{4}=1$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{4}{|4 x|\sqrt{16 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u.\end{aligned}
$$

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(4 x \right)}+C.
$$"] [:db/add "2d4c5a11-05bf-535e-9aa3-7c44f0124393" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "2d4c5a11-05bf-535e-9aa3-7c44f0124393" :question/answer-fields "3dcaa520-2b5c-5e6e-94c1-9fe1c20541f8" :question/id #uuid "3dcaa520-2b5c-5e6e-94c1-9fe1c20541f8"] [:db/add "3dcaa520-2b5c-5e6e-94c1-9fe1c20541f8" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{3}{|4 x|\sqrt{16 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

Work on a connected interval where $|4 x|>1$.

Choose the antiderivative. In each choice, $C$ is an arbitrary constant."] [:db/add "3dcaa520-2b5c-5e6e-94c1-9fe1c20541f8" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=4 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(4)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{4}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $3\cdot \frac{1}{4}=\frac{3}{4}$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{3}{|4 x|\sqrt{16 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{3}{4}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

$$
\frac{3}{4}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=\frac{3}{4}\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
\frac{3 \operatorname{arcsec}{\left(4 x \right)}}{4}+C.
$$"] [:db/add "3dcaa520-2b5c-5e6e-94c1-9fe1c20541f8" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "3dcaa520-2b5c-5e6e-94c1-9fe1c20541f8" :question/answer-fields "af0cf89b-f732-5f0a-8c57-8613ad487f68" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{1}{|x|\sqrt{4 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

Work on a connected interval where $|2 x|>1$.

Choose the antiderivative. In each choice, $C$ is an arbitrary constant."] [:db/add "af0cf89b-f732-5f0a-8c57-8613ad487f68" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=2 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(2)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{2}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $2\cdot \frac{1}{2}=1$.

$$

$$

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(2 x \right)}+C.

["87312669-caa3-5cc6-a042-e2cd54f8a473" :question/id #uuid "87312669-caa3-5cc6-a042-e2cd54f8a473"] ["87312669-caa3-5cc6-a042-e2cd54f8a473" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{4}{|2 x|\sqrt{4 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

Work on a connected interval where $|2 x|>1$.

Choose the antiderivative. In each choice, $C$ is an arbitrary constant."] ["87312669-caa3-5cc6-a042-e2cd54f8a473" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=2 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(2)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{2}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $4\cdot \frac{1}{2}=2$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{4}{|2 x|\sqrt{4 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=2\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

$$
2\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=2\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
2 \operatorname{arcsec}{\left(2 x \right)}+C.
$$"] ["87312669-caa3-5cc6-a042-e2cd54f8a473" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] ["87312669-caa3-5cc6-a042-e2cd54f8a473" :question/answer-fields "80e900ad-4468-5fc4-8ed1-9121bc66a208"] $$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

$$
2\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=2\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

$$

$$"] ["d5c52375-291e-5e77-89aa-497c8e0e0c18" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] ["d5c52375-291e-5e77-89aa-497c8e0e0c18" :question/answer-fields "8a38e249-d735-59b6-8e25-5b7a1bf06196"] ["86e40079-fe16-51f5-a559-e14b50e86a2d" :question/id #uuid "86e40079-fe16-51f5-a559-e14b50e86a2d"] ["86e40079-fe16-51f5-a559-e14b50e86a2d" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{3}{|2 x|\sqrt{4 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

Work on a connected interval where $|2 x|>1$.

Choose the antiderivative. In each choice, $C$ is an arbitrary constant."] ["86e40079-fe16-51f5-a559-e14b50e86a2d" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=2 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(2)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{2}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $3\cdot \frac{1}{2}=\frac{3}{2}$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{3}{|2 x|\sqrt{4 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{3}{2}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

$$
\frac{3}{2}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=\frac{3}{2}\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
\frac{3 \operatorname{arcsec}{\left(2 x \right)}}{2}+C.
$$"] ["86e40079-fe16-51f5-a559-e14b50e86a2d" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] ["86e40079-fe16-51f5-a559-e14b50e86a2d" :question/answer-fields "d10f510b-e1d6-5ef8-9977-6a607deb13d2"] "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{3}{|x|\sqrt{16 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x

Choose the antiderivative. In each choice, $C$ is an arbitrary constant."] ["84d48a0e-a46c-5216-855f-e957fa5dbdd5" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=4 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(4)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Because $4>0$, $|u|=4|x|$, so $|x|=|u|/4$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{4}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $12\cdot \frac{1}{4}=3$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{3}{|x|\sqrt{16 x^{2} - 1}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=3\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u=\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

$$
3\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u^{2} - 1} \left|{u}\right|}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=3\left(\operatorname{arcsec}{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
3 \operatorname{arcsec}{\left(4 x \right)}+C.
$$"] ["84d48a0e-a46c-5216-855f-e957fa5dbdd5" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard] ["84d48a0e-a46c-5216-855f-e957fa5dbdd5" :question/answer-fields "1e4143af-b98c-59a8-ac5c-3978859cbf85"]
